title: Land Surface Temperature (Sentinel-3)
description: Land surface temperature from Sentinel-3, correcting SLSTR thermal brightness temperature for emissivity estimated from OLCI NDVI. Returns temperature in degrees Celsius on the 300 m OLCI grid.

attribution.citation: Avdan, U., Jovanovska, G. (2016). Algorithm for Automated Mapping of Land Surface Temperature Using LANDSAT 8 Satellite Data. Journal of Sensors, 2016, 1480307.
